svg.title: Capabilities and Life Interests - Pronab Chakraborty
svg.desc: Grounded professional capabilities beside a 3-slide personal interests carousel on a 12-second cycle

text.tspan: Algorithmic art, custom shader experimentation, and expressive
canvas mechanics exploring the frontier where code and visual
expression unite into fluid responsive aesthetics.
Deep fascination with real-time game loop systems, spatial
physics simulations, immersive virtual worldbuilding, and
interactive mechanics that deliver immediate tactile feedback.
Hands-on experimentation with physical computing, microcontrollers,
custom mechanical hardware rigs, and bridging tactile physical
inputs directly into dynamic digital environments.

g.text: Algorithmic canvas mechanics and custom shader experimentation.
Interactive game loop logic, spatial physics, and virtual worlds.
Microcontrollers, custom mechanical rigs, and physical sensors.
